tools.name: describeCbvTerm
tools.description:
Get the CBV's own definition of a term, and its example of use. Use this to confirm that
a term means what you think before putting it in a document — the definitions are the
standard's text, not a paraphrase.

tools.name: digitalLinkToUrn
tools.description: Convert a GS1 Digital Link URI into the legacy EPC URN form. Supply the GCP (company prefix) length if you know it; pass 0 to let the resolver determine it. Only use URNs when the user explicitly asks for them — Digital Link is the preferred form.

tools.name: dpp
tools.description: The Digital Product Passport of a product, Lot or Serial by its GS1 Digital Link, from the DPP API (EN 18223 structure). Read with the user's sign-in, so the fields their access tier allows are included. representation: compressed (default), operational, full, gs1 or eu.

tools.name: findCbvTerms
tools.description:
Find candidate CBV terms for an EPCIS event field by matching words from a description
of what happened. Returns the terms whose names share a word stem with the description,
most specific first, or the whole list when nothing matches.

This is a NAME match, not a semantic one: it narrows the choice

tools.name: get_event
tools.description: One EPCIS event by its eventID, exactly as the repository holds it (JSON-LD), for the signed-in user.

tools.name: links
tools.description: The full GS1 Digital Link linkset of an identifier: every link type the resolver serves for it (product passport, master data, EPCIS repository, instructions and so on), with titles and languages.

tools.name: listCbvTerms
tools.description:
List every standard CBV term for an EPCIS event field. Use this instead of recalling
terms from memory — the list is small, closed, and generated from the CBV standard, and
a term that is not on it will be rejected when the document is captured.

tools.name: listDocumentIdentifiers
tools.description:
List the identifiers an EPCIS document actually uses, grouped by the field that carries
them. Use this to check at a glance that a document is about the objects and places you
intended, without reading the whole JSON.

tools.name: masterdata
tools.description: What the GS1 Digital Link resolver knows about a product (GTIN, Lot, Serial), a place (GLN, SGLN) or a party (PGLN): name, description, brand, location and the like, as the platform publishes it.

tools.name: query_events
